FN-X4IQZ7E-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 44
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Chris England
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/04/2024
House Bill 44 as introduced could increase the obligations of certain state, county, and
municipal custodial agencies by an undetermined amount dependent upon the cost to collect and
maintain certain information on detainees and to notify emergency contacts upon death or
serious injury of the detainee.
This bill would increase the obligations of the Bureau of Pardons and Paroles by a
bureau-estimated $100,000 annually to comply with the provisions of this bill.
